expectations.name: all boundary shapes classified as expected

cases.title: 主备屏切换 / 退出 / 恢复

expectations.name: snapshot in alt screen marks activeType=alternate
restored-from-A continues to final state == reference
final pipeline snapshot == reference end state
fidelity full

cases.title: 光标 / 模式 / 滚动 / resize

expectations.name: snapshot dims == last resize
modes survived round trip
cursor/scrollback/screen match reference
fidelity full
resize ops were processed in order

cases.title: 全程无浏览器仍持续消费（>256 KiB）

expectations.name: fed more than 256 KiB
all enqueued bytes applied
zero snapshots before the end
state matches reference
fidelity full

cases.title: 客户端游标再次被驱逐：gap 判定与快照重基线

expectations.name: first eviction detected as gap
snapshot cursor is usable (no gap)
second eviction detected as gap
second snapshot cursor is usable
cursor advanced (never jumped back to window start)
authority cursor is the resume cursor (D3 protocol)
recovery stays full (no feed lag)

cases.title: 异步 feed 后立即 snapshot（游标一致性）

expectations.name: producer-side probe shows enqueue != applied
immediate snapshot did not claim unapplied bytes
snapshot was consistent enough to restore and continue
barrier drains to the enqueue frontier
final snapshot after drain is full
snapshot wait did not block the producer (enqueue stayed synchronous)
snapshot dims == final resize (32x8)
restored state matches reference
fidelity full

cases.title: UTF-8 / CSI / OSC 跨快照边界恢复（后续接流不重放不丢）

expectations.name: snapshot taken with a non-empty pending tail
boundary prepared clean (held back, not force-fed)
OSC title makes the snapshot partial (measured: titles are not serialized)
restored + pending_tail + rest == reference (no replay, no loss)
pending tail equals stream[applied_bytes .. applied+boundary)

cases.title: 队列停滞/溢出 → 明确 degraded + 显式 reset baseline（不得自动 full）

expectations.name: overflow rejected explicitly (no silent drop)
feed_lag latched
snapshot while lagging is degraded/partial, never full
resetBaseline is explicit and returns partial (not full)
after reset the recovery stays partial (no auto-full)
post-baseline content keeps flowing with new baseline recorded
default queue budget is 4 MiB in the shipped pipeline

cases.title: DECSTBM（滚动区）序列化缺口：诚实 partial + 可复现差异

expectations.name: snapshot declares partial with DECSTBM reason
capability table records DECSTBM as a measured gap
the mismatch is real and reproducible (declared, not hidden)

cases.title: synchronized output (2026) 缺口：声明式降级

expectations.name: declared gap degrades fidelity
capability table records the gap
text content still restores (only the mode is lost)

cases.title: 真实 less.exe TUI 字节流回放（跨快照边界）

expectations.name: capture is a real ConPTY recording
mid-stream snapshot restored + continued == reference
snapshot boundary was parser-clean
real ConPTY stream degrades honestly (unlisted private mode detected)

cases.title: D3：parsed/resume 双游标协议 + 真实日志拉取（含尾巴被驱逐）

expectations.name: snapshot carries both cursors and a pending tail
protocol A (pull from parsed_cursor, no tail re-feed) == reference
protocol B (feed tail, pull from resume_cursor) == reference
mixing the two protocols consumes the pending tail twice (protocol violation)
evicted tail: stale cursor returns gap instead of window-start bytes
fresh snapshot cursor is usable again after eviction

cases.title: D1：强制喂入后 parser-dirty 粘滞（不得被下一块自愈）

expectations.name: force-fed long OSC marks dirty (partial)
next chunk does NOT clear the dirty marker (pre-fix bug)
even after the OSC terminates (BEL) the snapshot stays partial
explicit reset is the only escape and clears the dirty marker
after reset the snapshot is partial for the fresh-view reason (never auto-full)
long DCS force-fed -> partial, and still partial after ST terminates it

cases.title: D5：控制 op 有界 / 过期 mutation 不执行 / op 异常恢复 / 诊断有界

expectations.name: resize ops are rejected explicitly when the op budget is full
snapshot degrades after control-queue overflow
expired reset reported as timeout
expired reset did NOT execute later
a fresh explicit reset still works
injected op error is recorded and the loop keeps working
lag diagnostics are bounded

cases.title: D2：检测优先（未声明缺口/未知特性/未知 FEATURE_SUPPORT 键都降级）

expectations.name: no failed classification cases
plain text can still be full without any declaration

honesty_notes: All comparisons are headless-vs-headless internal consistency; no real browser was run (out of scope).
fidelity=full is only asserted for streams whose declared features are all measured-supported.
Known measured gaps (DECSTBM, synchronized output 2026, pending parser state) degrade fidelity or are covered structurally by the hold-back tail.
Unverified features (cursor style, window title, tab stops, charset, selection, SGR mouse encodings) force fidelity=partial when declared.
